title: Exploring the binding dynamics of triazolyl-thio-oxazines for MDM2-p53 disruption: Design, synthesis, and p53 upregulation.
authors: Narasimhachar, Bhanuprakash C; Nagaraja, Omantheswara; Ahn, Kwang Seok; Yang, Min Hee; Harish, Keshav Kumar; Madegowda, Mahendra; Bender, Andreas; Basappa, Basappa; Chandrashekara, Paduvalahippe Gowdegowda
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂与MDM2蛋白的结合动力学及p53上调，属蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The mouse double minute 2 homolog (MDM2) - p53 interaction inactivates p53, a key tumor suppressor, and has been validated as a target for cancer therapy. Four triazolyl-thio-oxazines 4(a-d) were rationally designed based on a three-finger pharmacophore model, which parallels the binding conformation of p53 to suppress this oncogenic interaction. All compounds were characterized by (1)H/(13)C NMR, IR, and mass spectrometry, whereas 4a was characterized by X-ray crystallography. All compounds bound to the MDM2 binding site at key residues (Leu54, Leu57, Ile61, Met62, Phe86, and Tyr100) with similar binding affinities (-7.88 to -8.75 kcal/mol). Further 200 ns molecular dynamics simulations and MM-GBSA analyses were performed to determine the precise differences. Complex 4a demonstrated better binding stability (RMSD <2.0 A) and MM-GBSA Binding Score DeltaG(bind) (-172.718 kcal/mol) than either Nutlin-3a or the p53 peptide. Its fluorobenzene dives further into the MDM2 cleft than the chlorobenzene ring in Nutlin-3a, resulting in stronger pi-pi stacking and hydrophobic interactions. SwissADME profiling also predicted that 4a has a good balance of pharmacokinetic properties. This was evident from the cytotoxicity studies (MCF-7 breast cancer cells), which revealed 4a to be the most potent (IC(5)(0) = 4.379 muM). Further Western blot analysis showed significant upregulation of p53 and p21 in MCF-7 cells upon treatment with 4(a-d). In contrast, no significant induction of p53 or p21 was observed in MDA-MB-468 cells, confirming the upregulation of wild-type p53. These results suggest that 4a is a promising candidate for further biological evaluation as an MDM2-p53 interaction inhibitor.
abstract_zh: 小鼠双微体2同源物（MDM2）-p53相互作用使关键肿瘤抑制因子p53失活，并已被验证为癌症治疗靶点。基于三指药效团模型，合理设计了四种三唑基-硫代恶嗪类化合物4(a-d)，该模型与p53的结合构象平行，以抑制这种致癌相互作用。所有化合物均通过(1)H/(13)C NMR、IR和质谱表征，其中4a通过X射线晶体学表征。所有化合物均结合至MDM2结合位点的关键残基（Leu54、Leu57、Ile61、Met62、Phe86和Tyr100），且结合亲和力相似（-7.88至-8.75 kcal/mol）。进一步进行了200 ns分子动力学模拟和MM-GBSA分析以确定精确差异。复合物4a表现出比Nutlin-3a或p53肽更好的结合稳定性（RMSD <2.0 Å）和MM-GBSA结合评分DeltaG(bind)（-172.718 kcal/mol）。其氟苯基比Nutlin-3a中的氯苯环更深入MDM2裂隙，导致更强的π-π堆积和疏水相互作用。SwissADME分析还预测4a具有良好的药代动力学性质平衡。这从细胞毒性研究（MCF-7乳腺癌细胞）中得以体现，显示4a是最有效的（IC(5)(0) = 4.379 μM）。进一步的Western blot分析显示，用4(a-d)处理后，MCF-7细胞中p53和p21显著上调。相反，在MDA-MB-468细胞中未观察到p53或p21的显著诱导，证实了野生型p53的上调。这些结果表明，4a作为MDM2-p53相互作用抑制剂，是进一步生物学评估的有前景候选物。
